Hi Linda,

Thanks again for your time today — appreciate the candid questions from you and the team. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Summary: Demo covered inference latency and cost controls, VPC/private deployment options, SOC2 controls, and our Dedicated offering for predictable throughput.
- Decision criteria you called out: data residency, SOC2 + pen test evidence, and invoicing via your vendor portal.

Ask from our side: can you confirm the primary procurement contact and typical PO cadence? Also want to map the economic buyer — you mentioned someone on the finance team (is that Rajiv?). If possible, please share the steps (vendor questionnaire, legal review, PO issuance, timeline).

Proposed immediate next items:
1) I will send a one-page mutual action plan and the quick vendor onboarding template for your procurement team.
2) If procurement requests our security pack (SOC2, pen-test summary, data retention policy), Marissa will drop answers to the RFI and the supportive docs.
3) Let's schedule a 30-min procurement sync with Rajiv and your procurement contact this week or early next.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_v1.pdf (draft)

Thanks — I want to make the onboarding friction-free for you.

Best,
Dylan

Subject: Re: Redwood demo — procurement next steps and stakeholder map

Dylan / Marissa,

Quick vendor onboarding details from procurement side:
- Required docs: completed vendor questionnaire (we prefer PDF), current W-9, company insurance certificate, and contact for billing.
- Security: we lean on SOC2 Type II reports; pen-test summaries are helpful but not always required if SOC2 is recent. There will be a short technical call with our security engineer (cc'd when scheduled).
- PO & payment: BrightBank issues POs via our vendor portal. Standard terms are Net30. For first-time vendor payments we need banking details for ACH and a registered remit-to address.
- Legal: small redlines to our standard order form are usually handled by our commercial counsel; major changes will go to legal and will add time.

Portal link: https://vendor.brightbank.com/portal/registration

If you can return the completed RFI and attach SOC2 + W-9 by end of week, we can queue you for the security call and target PO issuance in ~3–6 weeks.

Thanks,
Rajiv
Procurement Manager, BrightBank
